title: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2611.12935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes. We introduce TopicScope, a framework for training causal topic classifiers on SAE features that assign a topic to every token, so that the label can change partway through a response. We train three detector architectures on synthetic multi-topic conversations covering seven topics. Across Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on features extracted from prefill hidden states were able to generalise to decoding. We also found that the classifiers are robust to perturbations, losing at most 5 macro-F1 points when off-topic asides are inserted, topics are removed or sections are reordered. Ablations conducted to understand the contribution of the SAE revealed that classifiers reaching baseline

translated_title: 在预填充阶段训练，在解码阶段监控：使用稀疏自编码器进行主题监控
translated_abstract: 主题监控是在模型生成响应期间为响应中的每个token标记主题的任务。迄今为止，在生成时运行的基于激活的监控器主要用于检测有害内容，且仅限于两三个类别。我们提出了TopicScope，这是一个在稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征上训练因果主题分类器的框架，它能为每个token分配主题标签，使标签能够在响应中途发生变化。我们在涵盖七个主题的合成多主题对话上训练了三种检测器架构。在Gemma-3 1B和4B模型上，使用从预填充（prefill）隐藏状态中提取的特征训练的监控器能够泛化到解码阶段。我们还发现这些分类器对扰动具有鲁棒性：当插入离题的旁白、删除主题或重新排列章节时，macro-F1最多损失5分。为理解SAE的贡献而进行的消融实验表明，达到基线的分类器……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了TopicScope框架，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征训练因果主题分类器，在预填充阶段提取特征训练后可泛化到解码阶段，实现对生成过程中每个token的实时多主题监控且标签可中途变化。
en_tdlr: TopicScope is a framework for training causal topic classifiers on SAE features that assign per-token topic labels during generation, where monitors trained on prefill hidden states generalize to decoding and remain robust to perturbations.
